install_route: apt r-cran-{kernlab,optimx,rgenoud} + git clone github.com/j-hai/Synth + R CMD INSTALL; CRAN itself is unreachable from this sandbox, see benchmarks/R/install_sc_references.sh

reference_source.note: function_SCM-CS_v07.R and smoking_dataset.csv are not redistributed here; reference_authors.R takes their directory as its first argument. The driver script california_beta_testing_2018-08-12.R is reproduced in reference_authors.R with the working directory and the doParallel backend dropped.

spec.weights: R Synth 1.2.0, synth(method = 'BFGS'), one fit per unit with the other 38 as controls
spec.predictors: lnincome, beer, age15to24, retprice; mean over 1980-1988
spec.note: This is the driver's specification, which is not ADH 2010's: ADH gives beer a special predictor over 1984-1988, the driver averages it with the other predictors over 1980-1988.
